simple.summary: רְעַע (rᵉʻaʻ) means break, bruise. First listed occurrence: Dan 2 40.

definitions.full: H7490. rea [ רְעַע ] verb crush, shatter ( ᵑ7 Syriac; see Biblical Hebrew רצץ ); — Pe`al Imperfect 3feminine singular (וְ)תֵרֹעַ Dan 2:40 (object omitted). Pa`el Participle active מִרָעַע Dan 2:40 (accusative of thing).
